The Business Insights team is one of the branch's main data analytics teams, made up of data engineers, data analysts / dashboard developers, and data scientists who work together across the full data lifecycle \- from data sourcing and modelling to advanced analytics and insight delivery. We focus on the delivery of data marts, business intelligence (BI) products, statistical modelling and data analysis that creates valuable insights to influence operational and policy decision\-making.


**He angitutanga \| About the Role**



Reporting to Manager of Business Insights, this is a hands\-on BI leadership role \- ideal for someone currently operating at a Senior or Principal BI Developer level who wants to broaden their influence and lead by doing.



As the Practice Lead, you'll design and build advanced Power BI and SAS Viya dashboards, develop reusable datasets and data models, and champion best practice across the BI function. You'll set the standard for design, quality, and usability, ensuring our BI products are trusted, consistent, and deliver real business value.In this role, you will:


* Lead and facilitate workshops with business users to gather requirements and identify reporting and insight opportunities.
* Translate complex business questions into analytical use cases and intuitive data visualisations that drive understanding and action.
* Design, build, and maintain advanced Power BI and SAS Viya dashboards that deliver clear, actionable insights.
* Collaborate with data engineers to develop and optimise reusable datasets, data models, and automated pipelines, ensuring scalability and efficiency.
* Establish and embed best practices for BI development, including version control, automation, performance optimisation, and visual design standards.
* Work collaboratively with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated, secure, and high\-quality BI solutions.
* Ensure an enterprise\-wide approach to BI, focusing on consistency, governance, privacy, and quality data from source.
* Mentor and coach dashboard developers and analysts to lift technical capability, data storytelling, and visual design skills.
* Work with the Manager, Business Insights to plan and manage BI activities, including development, migration, and governance initiatives.
* Promote and grow DIA's Business Intelligence practice, fostering a culture of data\-driven decision\-making across the organisation.


**Mou \| About you**



We are looking for an experienced BI professional who enjoys both the technical and collaborative sides of analytics. You're comfortable being hands\-on \- building dashboards, refining data models, and experimenting with new tools \- while guiding others and bringing together the best of engineering, analytics, and data science to create real business impact. You will bring:


* Significant experience (7 plus years) in BI development and data analytics, with a proven track record of delivering dashboards and insights that influence organisational decision\-making.
* Advanced technical proficiency in Power BI (visualisation, DAX, data modelling, governance, and ETL).
* Experience with other BI tools (e.g. SAS Viya, Tableau, Qlik) is desirable.
* Strong skills in SQL and solid understanding of database structures, data warehousing principles, and data modelling best practice.
* Excellent data visualisation and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for non\-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to lead and deliver BI projects \- from requirements gathering to dashboard delivery \- in collaboration with business users, data engineers, and analysts.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and customer focus, with the ability to translate business questions into analytical solutions.
* Experience mentoring and coaching junior analysts or developers to lift capability and confidence.
* Understanding of agile methodologies and a willingness to work in a flexible, iterative environment (desirable)
* Knowledge of additional languages such as R or Python and familiarity with or curiosity about application of AI (desirable).


We'll be reviewing applications as they come in and may progress with interviews before the closing date. If this role sounds like you, we encourage you to apply early.

* Design, build, and deploy predictive, machine learning, and advanced AI models to solve operational and strategic challenges, including time\-series forecasting models (daily/weekly/monthly), model monitoring and drift detection.

* Experiment with emerging tools, techniques, and generative AI capabilities to unlock new value from data.

* 2–4 years’ experience applying data science or AI to solve business or service delivery problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R, with practical experience in model development and evaluation.
* Familiarity with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, or Databricks.
